short_goal: Create a high-energy vertical YouTube Short (9:16) that is 15-30 seconds long. Tone: bold, contrarian, confident.
instructions_for_model: Produce JSON only. Create 3-4 scenes: hook, 1-2 tips, CTA. Each scene must include: title (1-2 short lines), subtitle (short supporting line), duration_seconds (integer), and visual_hint (optional single-word hint for background). Keep lines short and punchy. Make language fit the 'Sigma Vibes' niche. Return JSON with keys: scenes (array) and total_duration (int).
